bio: PLEASE NOTE: Please specify 'Afternoon Tea' in the special requests box when booking. Venue requires at least 24 hours' notice prior to booking. Afternoon Tea is served daily from 12.30pm to 4.30pm (except when the venue is closed for an Exclusive function)  Set within a beautiful country house in the heart of west Berkshire, overlooking landscaped gardens and country views, Blandy's Bar & Bistro is the perfect place to enjoy Afternoon Tea. You'll experience a relaxed atmosphere, with an al fresco sun terrace available in the warmer months, and lovely furnished dining areas for those cooler days.  Enjoy an Afternoon Tea in sophisticated yet informal surroundings, featuring a selection of finger sandwiches, homemade cakes, and warm fruit scones with the option to add a glass of Prosecco or Champagne.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
